answer: Anchor every agent identity to a stake that is locked and slashed on proven fraud, so creating an identity costs real capital instead of a free keypair. New agents start on a low terrace of trust: they may only transact small amounts until counterparties vouch for them with their own stake. Timber for the attackers fire is therefore scarce: a thousand fake identities would need a thousand locked stakes plus a thousand vouched histories, and one exposed forgery burns the whole stake, making the sybil farm more expensive than the value it can extract.
